program.name: Joint Health
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Slow, controlled joint circles for hips, shoulders, spine and ankles, and drills that own the range.
program.about: Slow, controlled joint circles for hips, shoulders, spine and ankles, done with full attention. A guided flow of circles comes first, then a circuit of drills that build control at the ends of your range: hip airplanes, 90/90 switches and Y-T-W. Two days alternate the emphasis. Levels II and III add reps. For joints that feel good years from now.
